description: Search the CuNi catalog by free text — CuNi exactness — the law, the check gate, the spend-control example, and CuNi Bank. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use cuni_get when you already know the entry id.

q.description: Free-text query matched against entry id, name, notes, price, and URL. Omit or send an empty string to list every entry in the catalog.

name: cuni_search
